sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shivam Singh
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.
Applicants are represented by three counsel namely Sri Adarsh Kumar, Sri Aditya Kumar Yadav and Sri Deepankar Chaudhary, who are not present.
However, today when the matter was taken up for hearing none appeared.
Even Sri Shivam Singh, learned counsel for complainant is also not present.
Sri Shyam Narayan, learned A.G.A. is present.
2. This Court has passed following order on 13.5.2024:
"1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2, learned State counsel and perused the record.

Jogendra Singh @ Jugendra Singh And 7 ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127320116/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The present application has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash impugned charge sheet no. 341 of 2019, dated 18.10.2019 as well as cognizance order dated 12.12.2019 and entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 2929 of 2019, arising out of Case Crime No. 0175 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 427 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act P.S. Sindhauli, District Shahjahanpur pending in the court of learned A.C.J.M.-I, Shahjahanpur.
It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants argued that the parties have entered into compromise which is dated 06.11.2023, copy of the said compromise is annexed as Annexure no. S.C.A.1 to the short counter affidavit in support of present 482 Cr.P.C.
application.
It is argued that as such the present proceedings be quashed.

4. Looking to the facts of the case, it is provided that the applicants shall file the said compromise within a period of three weeks from today before the court concerned who shall verify the same within two weeks thereafter and send his report to this Court.

5. List after two months.
6.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case."

3. It is not on record as to whether above referred order has been complied with or not and there is report of Trial Court.
4.
In aforesaid circumstances, this application is rejected.
5. Interim order, passed earlier is vacated.
6. Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.

Order Date :- 10.9.2024 SB  Jogendra Singh @ Jugendra Singh And 7 ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127320116/
